action.description: plan evaluates the safety checks without changing anything. execute takes a snapshot first (the disk is kept) and deletes the disk in a later execute once the snapshot has completed.

zone.description: Zone of the disk, e.g. us-central1-a. Regional disks are not supported.

disk.description: Name of the persistent disk to delete, in the project of the function.

pvName.description: Name of the PersistentVolume the disk was created for (kubernetes.io/created-for/pv/name in its description). Confirm in the cluster that this PersistentVolume no longer exists first.

snapshot.description: Take a snapshot and wait for it to complete before deleting. Only set to false when the data is known to be disposable.
